variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .375 CheyTac
variants.info:
Load your Intervention with .375 CheyTac.
The alternative ammo that the Intervention can be made to fire featuring faster muzzle velocity but reduced penetration and range.
